data.value: Aztec can encode any text, up to a limited size.

data.name: RuleCode128
data.value: Code 128 encodes ASCII characters (letters without accents, digits and common symbols).

data.name: RuleCode39
data.value: Code 39 encodes ASCII characters, up to 80 of them. The * character is reserved.

data.name: RuleCode93
data.value: Code 93 encodes ASCII characters, up to 80 of them.

data.name: RuleCodabar
data.value: Codabar encodes digits and the symbols - $ : / . +, optionally between a start and a stop character taken from A, B, C, D.

data.name: RuleDataMatrix
data.value: Data Matrix can encode any text, up to a limited size.

data.name: RuleEan13
data.value: EAN-13 needs 12 digits (the check digit is added) or 13 digits (the last one is the check digit).

data.name: RuleEan8
data.value: EAN-8 needs 7 digits (the check digit is added) or 8 digits (the last one is the check digit).

data.name: RuleItf
data.value: ITF needs an even number of digits, up to 80.

data.name: RulePdf417
data.value: PDF417 can encode any text, up to a limited size.

data.name: RuleUpcA
data.value: UPC-A needs 11 digits (the check digit is added) or 12 digits (the last one is the check digit).

data.name: RuleUpcE
data.value: UPC-E needs 7 digits (number system 0 or 1, then 6 digits; the check digit is added) or 8 digits (the last one is the check digit).

data.name: ShowTypeOptionDescription
data.value: When reading, writes the type of each barcode before its text, separated by a tab (for example EAN-13, a tab, then the text). A line break inside a text is then written as \n, so that each barcode stays on one line. This also applies when the image holds several barcodes.
